· Position vs SMA100/200 ($0.20/$0.21): strong mid-to-long term trend strength.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (59.6→68.9) + nearing overbought territory, indicating continued upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0008→0.0006) + slight worsening, signaling weak trend reversal potential.
· Bollinger Band current price position (upper band $0.28) + band width at 29.31% suggests moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.25) + based on SMA5 and Pivot PP.
· Swing resistance ($0.28) + potential for strengthened uptrend upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways) + suggesting potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.42x) + increased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + consider buying on confirmation of $0.28 breakout for further upside.
